programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: Horror Hotel
programme.desc: After Nan Barlow's disappearance, her boyfriend and brother set off to Whitewood, Massachusetts to search for her, only to find a coven of witches controlling the town.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: På Westberg High School regerer tre populære skønhedsdronninger, der alle hedder Heather til fornavn. Veronica hader de tre Heather-piger, og går sammen med den rebelske Jason Dean for at få hævn over de tre piger.

programme.title: Under træet
programme.desc: Agnes smider Atli ud hjemmefra og nægter ham at se deres datter Ása. Atli må flytte hjem til sine forældre, der selv er i problemer i en bitter nabostrid omkring deres store smukke træ, der kaster en skygge på naboens terrasse.

programme.title: Old School
programme.desc: Tre mænd genoplever deres sorgløse collegetid ved at dræbe så mange hjerneceller, de kan, i denne forskruede komedie. Mitch kommer hjem fra en mindre behagelig forretningsrejse og afslører sin kone Heidi midt i en trekant.

programme.title: Waiting . . .
programme.desc: Ryan Reynolds, Anna Ferris og Justin Long serverer grinene som unge tjenere og servitricer, der søger en mening med livet, kærligheden og venskabet i denne forrygende komedie.

programme.title: Vi holder med flodhestene
programme.desc: Som altid er de to brødre konstant på kant, men en ting kan få dem til at finde sammen igen. Hvis der er andre, der skal have nogle øretæver og det sker tit. Denne gang er de taget til Afrika, hvor de lever af at tage skydegale turister på safari.

programme.title: Pas på, politiet kommer
programme.desc: Slagsbrødrene Wilbur Walsh (Bud Spencer) og Matt Kirby (Terence Hill) slår pjalterne sammen og planlægger at røve et supermarked, men planen går så skævt, at de to småforbrydere i stedet ender med at melde sig ind i politikorpset!

programme.title: 3 Days to Kill
programme.desc: Da den garvede CIA agent Ethan Renner ender på hospitalet efter en mislykket mission, får han at vide, at han kun har få måneder at leve i. Han opsøger sin datter og kone, som han ikke har set i årevis.

programme.title: Hot Seat
programme.desc: IT-ekspert Friar finder en bombe spændt fast til sin skrivebordsstol, og en uset hacker beordrer ham til at stjæle digitale pengebeløb online – ellers vil hans datter blive bortført.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Skatteøen

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Kvinder vil vide det

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Nadirs stjerne
programme.desc: En anonym sultans kone Danielle dør under mystiske omstændigheder i ørkenen. Hun havde imidlertid bedt Sydney om hjælp. Sydney tror, at Danielle ledte efter Nadirs stjerne.

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle I: Day 2
programme.desc: Et fire timer langt program hvor roastmesteren Jeff Ross er vært. 16 komikere dyster, men kun en kan vinde dette Roast Battle. Aftenens gæstedommere er Whoopi Goldberg og Anthony Jeselnik.

programme.title: The Roast of William Shatner

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mighty Casey

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Bevis

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Passage for Trumpet

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Chaser
programme.desc: A man, desperate to win the affection of a beautiful woman, slips her a love potion. He is overjoyed that the potion works so well...at first.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Stop at Willoughby
programme.desc: Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare as a Child
programme.desc: Schoolteacher Helen Foley finds a strange and very serious little girl on the stairs outside her apartment. The little girl seems to know her and tries to jog her memory about a man she saw earlier that day. The man arrives at Helen's door…

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Paranormal enthusiasts have theorized that Somerset County’s enthralling paranormal finds may have more to do with the geomagnetic anomalies present in its unique land that yield results which are fascinating to some and terrifying to others.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Long before the first funeral home was established in Manchester, Kentucky in 1938, there was the Chestnut House. The Chestnut family dedicated one of the home’s parlors to store the caskets they made.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Joan Rivers, David Carradine, Scott Baio, Teri Polo
programme.desc: Joan Rivers asks a voodoo priestess to help her with an angry ghost.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Barry Williams, Debi Mazar, Greg Grunberg, Sammy Hagar
programme.desc: When Barry Williams holds a memorial service for his father, a few strange "happenings" make the day even more unforgettable; Debi Mazer gets a hostile welcome from a ghost when she moves into a friend's home.

programme.title: Celebrity Ghost Stories (Classics): Carrie Fisher, Rue McClanahan, John Waters, Federico Castelluccio
programme.desc: Carrie Fisher has a spooky experience after her best friend dies in her bed; John Waters still remembers a scary night in the woods back in the 1950s.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Mother & Child
programme.desc: Karen bortadopterede en lille pige, da hun var 14 år gammel, men selv om hun aldrig har mødt hende, fylder datteren meget i Karens tanker. Advokaten Elizabeth er adoptivbarn og har fuld gang i karrieren, men i sit privatliv er hun ensom.

programme.title: The Cider House Rules
programme.desc: Den Oscar®-vindende publikumsfavorit om en mand, der søger efter et tilhørssted. Filmatiseret af bestsellerromanen, John Irvings stærke lektion om livet, kærlighed og hjemmet fik ros af kritikere og biografgæster over alt.

programme.title: You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger
programme.desc: Woody Allen er tilbage i formidabel form med en vittig og begavet storbykomedie om to generationers passioner, kriser og fortumlede forsøg på at finde lykken.

programme.title: Hot Rod
programme.desc: En komedie om en stuntmann som aldri har greid å lande uten å besvime og om forsøket på å mestre sitt livs største stunt.

programme.title: Lige eller ulige
programme.desc: Halvbrødrene Johnny (Terence Hill) og Charlie (Bud Spencer) sendes på en hemmelig mission for at afsløre bagmændende bag gangstervældet, der har bredt sig i Floridas sports og spille miljø.

programme.title: Cold War
programme.desc: 'Cold War' er en passioneret kærlighedshistorie om to mennesker med meget forskellig baggrund og vidt forskellige temperamenter. De er helt forkerte for hinanden, men er alligevel via skæbnen dømt til at forblive sammen.

programme.title: Final Target
programme.desc: Ava er en dødsensfarlig lejesoldat, der har højprofilerede lejemord som speciale. Men en opgave går galt, og hendes arbejdsgivere sender i al hemmelighed en lejemorder efter hende...

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Liam Neeson er tilbage som den tidligere CIA-agent Bryan Mills, der er ved at blive forsonet med sin ekskone, da hun bliver brutalt myrdet. Mills bliver beskyldt for mordet og tager flugten optændt af raseri og med CIA, FBI og politiet i hælene.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hvad sker der med en udskudt rev?
programme.desc: Andromeda modtager et råb om hjælp fra Rev Bam.

programme.title: Andromeda: Spidsen af spyddet
programme.desc: Efter at en planet i Commonwealth bliver angrebet af pyroformere fra Pyrian, er Dylan tvunget til at kæmpe for at beskytte den nye planet.

programme.title: Mutant X: Tiltrækningskunst
programme.desc: Mens Mutant X-holdet kæmper for at finde en formel, der er gemt i en samling kunstværker, får Shalimar vigtige oplysninger fra en mystisk kilde.

programme.title: Mutant X: Et normalt liv
programme.desc: Mutant X opsporer en uærlig videnskabsmand, mens Shalimar bryder ud fra holdet for at hjælpe Adam med at redde videnskabsmanden - og afsløre den virkelige skurk.

programme.title: The FBI Files: When Seconds Count
programme.desc: On July 2nd 1994, a 12-year-old girl was abducted from her home in northern California. The FBI knows to act fast, search wide, enlist volunteers. But as the hours slipped by, agents also realized their chances for recovering her alive grew slim.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dixie Mafia
programme.desc: On Mississippi's Gulf Coast, a Judge and his politician wife are murdered in their home. The killer left few clues. It looked like a professional hit, and the investigation led nowhere. But the FBI refused to give up.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the early 1990's Philadelphia became the scene of a bloody vendetta. The streets erupted in mob warfare. Authorities feared innocent people would be caught in the crossfire.

programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head try to stay awake all night, in an attempt to discover the secret behind morning wood. / For his oral report on an historical figure, Beavis recounts the valuable lessons he learned one night while eating at Burger World.

programme.desc: The show parodies Leave It to Beaver / The duo needs to go to a hospital / Beavis cries and is mocked unrelentlessly / Highland experiences a toxic gas leak

programme.desc: When the lieutenant governor's brother goes missing, the FBI swings in to help the deputies.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Raineesha X
programme.desc: Williams discovers the Nation of Islam and changes her ways, while Clemmy and Dangle throw down at a fraternity costume contest.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clementine and Garcia are Dating
programme.desc: After getting it on with nearly every other man in Reno, Johnson finally hooks up with Garcia, and Dangle breaks out his chimney sweep costume.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Undercover Drug Bust
programme.desc: Jones and Garcia enjoy their undercover stakeout a little too much, and Dangle and Clemmy start the department's first rock band.

programme.title: RENO 911!: President Bush in Reno
programme.desc: Reno's finest take on traffic control for President George W. Bush's motorcade, and Jones and Garcia reenact the Civil War at a pizza parlor.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Accidental Marriage
programme.desc: Garcia shoots a Dungeons & Dragons player, and Junior accidentally gets married during a sting operation.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Milkshake Man's Death
programme.desc: Reno District Attorney Mike Powers investigates the Sheriff's Department.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Investigation Concluded
programme.desc: District Attorney Mike Powers concludes his investigation of the Sheriff's Department, while Terry the prostitute takes off in Reno's police helicopter.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Terrorist Training Pt. 1
programme.desc: The Office of Homeland Security teaches the Reno Sheriff's Department terrorist attack protocol, and Clemmy's mom gets into trouble.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Terrorist Training Pt. 2
programme.desc: The Reno Sherriff's Department passes their Homeland Security exam with flying colors, and Clemmy and a drunk driver discover some new moves.

programme.title: The Roast of Charlie Sheen
programme.desc: I hver udgave af 'The Roast of' bliver en kendis ristet over en sagte ild og pillet ned af venner og fjender. Det er Charlie Sheens tur til at sætte sig i kendissernes varme stol i det nyeste afsnit af The Comedy Central Roast.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Roasts Criminals
programme.desc: Amerikas Roastmester generalen selv, Jeff Ross, giver den farligste - og mest oplysende - roast i sit liv fra bag murene af Brazos-fængslet i Bryan, Texas.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle II
programme.desc: Jeff Ross tager på turné som vært for Roast Battle i amerikanske byer. Der er kendte gæstedommere, deltagerne går på scenen og prøver at overgå hinanden i grovheder for at vinde mesterskabsbæltet.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle I: Live Finals
programme.desc: Et fire timer langt program hvor roastmesteren Jeff Ross er vært. 16 komikere dyster, men kun en kan vinde dette Roast Battle. I aftenens live finale er gæstedommerne Sarah Silverman og Judd Apatow.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Big Tall Wish
programme.desc: An over-the-hill boxer gets a boost from one of his biggest fans - a little boy with an unwavering belief in magic.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Execution
programme.desc: Just before being hanged for shooting a man in the back, a man in 1880 is transported into the year 1959 by a professor who soon realizes that he has brought forward a savage killer.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: People Are Alike All Over
programme.desc: When a space exploration crashes on Mars, the surviving passenger is surprised to find that Martians are human-looking, very friendly and apparently just like us...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: And When the Sky Was Opened
programme.desc: Three astronauts have returned from this first space flight. Major Gart is hospitalized with a broken leg. The other two, Colonels Harrington and Forbes head for a bar. Harrington gets a strange feeling…

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Trouble with Templeton
programme.desc: A nostalgic actor revisits his late wife and friends at their old haunt, only to find that he is now out of place there.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Most Unusual Camera
programme.desc: When three dum-dum crooks get ahold of a camera that takes pictures of the future, they set out to make a quick fortune with their new toy.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Night of the Meek
programme.desc: After a derelict Santa Claus is fired on Christmas Eve, he finds a mysterious bag that gives out presents. With this bag, he sets out to fulfill his one wish - to see the less fortunate inherit the bounties of Christmas.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Dust
programme.desc: In a tragic, western town, a desperate father begs for clemency as his son is slated to die for an accident he could not have prevented.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Eric Dickerson
programme.desc: NFL great, Eric Dickerson fears that there are spirits in his Calabasas, California home tormenting his children.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: Dark Star DA
programme.desc: Vi er i midten af det 21. århundarede, og mennesket har udforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forladt Jorden for at finde nye hjem i universet. Det bevæbnede rumskib "Dark Star" skal bane vej for alle disse fredelige kolonister.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksassistent støder på en mystisk plante med sult efter blod. Succes følger, men prisen viser sig at være menneskeliv, og situationen eskalerer.

programme.title: Fårfejden
programme.desc: Colin og Les opdrætter prisvindende får på en gård i et lille australsk samfund. Da en sygdom spreder sig blandt dyrene, og myndighederne beslutter, at alle fårene i dalen skal aflives, må mændene arbejde sammen for at redde deres levebrød.

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: Ryan Bingham lever et højtsvævende liv. Han flyver over hele verden på forretningsrejser og er stadig på farten. Men så møder han medpassageren Alex og lærer, at livet ikke handler om rejsen, men om kontakterne man får på vejen.

programme.title: Barefoot
programme.desc: En rig families "sorte får" møder en ung psykiatrisk patient, der er vokset op isoleret hele sit liv. Han tager den naive unge kvinde med hjem til sin brors bryllup.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: Will erfarer, at hans kæreste Amy har en affære med undertøjsmodellen Flavor. Da Will efterfølgende holder en fest kommer Amy med sin nye flamme. Pludselig begynder alt at ryste. Det viser sig, at jorden på samme tid rammes af alle naturkatastrofer.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Neil er en rigtig filmnørd, som ejer en lille videobutik. Når han ikke sidder fastklistret foran fjernsynet og en eller anden film noir, diskuterer han film med sine to medarbejdere, supernørden Lucien og den noget stabilere Jonathan.

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: Byen Stepford har en hemmelighed. Alle hustruerne er alt for perfekte og alle mændene er alt for lykkelige. Denne komiske thriller er en genindspilning af den spændende klassiker fra 1975. Velkommen til Stepford- den amerikanske drøm.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Gilbert Grape (Johnny Depp) bor i Endora, hvor der ikke sker ret meget. Han er ansvarlig for at passe på sin autistiske bror Arnie (Leonardo DiCaprio). En dag kommer Becky til byen, og Gilbert bliver forelsket, men det er svært at få lidt privatliv.

programme.title: The Con is On
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at slippe for at betale en gigantisk spillegæld, flygter Harriet og Peter til Hollywood. Planen er, at infiltrere et juvelrøveri som involverer Peters eks-kone.

programme.title: The Prince
programme.desc: Den pensionerede forbryderkonge og enlige far Paul, tvinges til at vende tilbage til Las Vegas og det kriminelle samfund, da hans datter kidnappes.

programme.title: Mutant X: Delte loyaliteter
programme.desc: Brennan er tvunget til at vende tilbage til sin kriminelle fortid, da Mutant X opdager, at hans gamle partner er involveret i at stjæle hemmeligheder fra Dominion.

programme.title: Mutant X: Uskyldens tidsalder
programme.desc: Mutant X finder frem til et gammelt militæreksperiment med et serum til omvendelse af alder og bliver overrasket over at opdage, at Jesses bedstefar er en af forsøgspersonerne.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Djævledukke
programme.desc: En guide fører Sydney og Nigel til et usædvanligt, underjordisk Aztec gravkammer. I stedet for et lig finder de et relikvie.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Incognito
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel finder en mytisk lancet og støder på Nigels dobbeltgænger lige før hans død. Nigel får et snit fra lancetten. Senere overtaler Cate Nigel til at udgive sig for at være manden.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Alle kvalt
programme.desc: Carson Inez, en samler, bruger en gammel halskæde til at få Sydney til at hjælpe hende med at opfostre Athena, som så vil hjælpe hende med at erobre verden.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1970s, cities across the United States became a battleground for vicious Croatian radicals. Their violent agenda targeted their own people living in America.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.desc: On Halloween, the deputies prepare for a night of mayhem, and Wiegel sets a sting operation to catch mischievous teens.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Promotion
programme.desc: Dangle gets a new job in Carson City, but the deputies are too wrapped up in women's basketball to give him a proper send-off.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: Wiegel's new boyfriend, Craig, bears an uncanny resemblance to the Truckee River Serial Killer.

programme.title: RENO 911!: British Law
programme.desc: Inspector Martin Smiley of the U.K. joins the Reno Sheriff's Department in an exchange program.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Wife Visits
programme.desc: Divorce looms over Dangle and his estranged wife, and the rest of the department struggles with a giant Ten Commandments monument.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Religion in Reno
programme.desc: The Reverend Gigg LeCarp, Reno's favorite televangelist, saves the deputies in their very own jail.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Fire Fighters Are Jerks
programme.desc: The accursed Fire Department schedules its Pancake Dinner at the same time as the Policeman's Ball.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Not Without My Mustache
programme.desc: As the deputies struggle to save their moustaches from a county-ordered shave, Jones worries about a psychic's prediction.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Security for Kenny Rogers
programme.desc: Deputy Garcia lives his lifelong dream: leading security for a Kenny Rogers book signing.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle I: Day 3
programme.desc: Et fire timer langt program hvor roastmesteren Jeff Ross er vært. 16 komikere dyster, men kun en kan vinde dette Roast Battle. Aftenens gæstedommere er Jimmy Kimmel og Seth Rogen.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Presents: Roast Battle II
programme.desc: Jeff Ross tager på turné som vært for Roast Battle i amerikanske byer. Der er kendte gæstedommere, deltagerne går på scenen og prøver at overgå hinanden i grovheder for at vinde mesterskabsbæltet.

programme.title: Jeff Ross Roasts Cops
programme.desc: Roastmester general Jeff Ross taler med Black Lives Matter-aktivister, kører en øjenåbnende tur med politiet og roaster folk fra Boston Politi.

programme.title: The Roast of Bob Saget
programme.desc: I hver udgave af "The Roast of" bliver en kendis ristet over en sagte ild og pillet ned af venner og fjender. Den aggressivt venlige skuespiller fra "Hænderne Fulde" og "Sjov og spas".

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Back There
programme.desc: At a prominent club in Washington, D.C., a socialite argues about whether it would be possible to change history by traveling back in time. When he leaves the club he finds himself in 1865, on the night that President Lincoln will be shot.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Whole Truth
programme.desc: A used car salesman buys a car that dooms him to tell only the truth.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Invaders
programme.desc: When a woman investigates a clamor on the roof of her rural house, she discovers a small UFO and little aliens emerging from it. Or so it seems.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Penny For Your Thoughts
programme.desc: Gaining telepathic abilities when his coin lands on its edge bank clerk Hector B. Poole learns about the difference between other people's plans and fantasies.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Twenty-Two
programme.desc: While in the hospital recovering from overwork, Liz Powell keeps dreaming about going down to the hospital morgue.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Odyssey of Flight 33
programme.desc: Passing through the sound barrier a commercial airliner inadvertently travels back in time.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Dingle, the Strong
programme.desc: A timid vacuum-cleaner salesman is given the strength of 300 men by some experimenting aliens.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Static
programme.desc: An old radio is taking bitter bachelor Ed Lindsay back to a happier time before what he considers worthless tripe on television when he starts picking up radio programs from the 1930's and 1940's.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Kevin Sorbo
programme.desc: Legendary actor, Kevin Sorbo returns to an idyllic lake in Texas where he encountered a ghostly apparition so disturbing it haunts him to this day.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Tutbury Castle
programme.desc: The team head to Tutbury Castle in Derbyshire to investigate the paranormal reports at the location. Past Hunters appear to have caught the Tutbury Ghost on camera.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Ordsall Hall
programme.desc: Ordsall Hall is over 820 years old. It has been put to many uses including a family home, working men's club and church hall. With over 15 hauntings and many sightings, Ordsall Hall will certainly keep the team busy.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Thackray Medical Museum
programme.desc: Derek Acorah's The Past Hunters investigate Thackray Medical Museum, believed to one of Leeds most haunted buildings. Workers claim to have witnessed constant paranormal activity in the museum and one claim is that two Victorian ghosts are trapped...

programme.title: Past Hunters: The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Hull to investigate ghostly goings on inside of a former chocolate factory. The investigation turns out to be no picnic, as the ghosts haunting make direct contact with the team.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: The Night Of The Hunter
programme.desc: Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll. Shelley Winters co-stars.

programme.title: Upside of Anger
programme.desc: Den midaldrende husmor Terrys liv bliver vendt på hovedet, da hendes mand pludselig flytter til Sverige med sin sekretær. Snart begynder Terry at føle sig tiltrukket af mandens bedste ven, den tidligere baseballstjerne Denny.

programme.title: Wonder Wheel
programme.desc: ”Wonder Wheel” er historien om fire menneskers liv, der flettes sammen i en charmerende og travl forlystelsespark på Coney Island.

programme.title: Meet the Spartans
programme.desc: Det store slag har sin begyndelse da helten Leonidas – kun bevæbnet med læderundertøj og en kappe – førersin gruppe af 13(!) krigere mod nord for at forsvare hjemlandet mod…

programme.title: Med Røven I Vandskorpen
programme.desc: Bill Murray spiller hovedrollen som Tripper Harrison, lejrchefen på Camp North Star. Der er masser af sjov og ballade i vente, mens han sammen med lejrens øvrige ledere gør, hvad han kan for at bryde alle regler.

programme.title: Pumping Iron
programme.desc: Arnold Schwarzenegger og Lou Ferrigno står over for hinanden i en konkurrence, hvor alle kneb gælder, om titlen som Mr. Olympia i denne anmelderroste film, der gjorde Schwarzenegger til et kendt navn.

programme.title: Gi' den hele armen
programme.desc: Trinity brødrene, som vi har vredet os af grin over som western helte, skal her opleves som luftens cowboys. Luften over Sydamerika er blevet temmelig usikker. De to helte skal sørge for at få gamle højt forsikrede flyvemaskiner til at styrte ned.

programme.title: The Vows We Keep
programme.desc: En eventplanlægger finder kærligheden, da hun arbejder med at arrange det sidste bryllup på et historisk værtshus.

programme.title: Eye in the Sky
programme.desc: Helen Mirren, Aaron Paul og Alan Rickman medvirker i denne politiske spændingsfilm. Ved en militæroperation har man chancen for at dræbe tre fremtrædende terrorister, men etikken komplicerer tingene.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Nu Theta Phi's troldmand
programme.desc: Da Sydneys studerende Megs værelseskammerat finder en hekseamulet, bliver Meg indlagt på hospitalet. Megs kærestes broderskabsbror kører et kapløb for at få fat i amuletten. Hvad er han ude på?

programme.title: Andromeda: Himlens hvælving
programme.desc: Dylan hører stemmer, der lokker ham til en planet med "ild og is".

programme.title: Andromeda: Deep Midnight's Voice
programme.desc: Mens besætningen er fanget i en kamp mellem to nietzscheanske stolthedspunkter, fanger besætningen en fjendtlig person, der hævder, at hans stolthed har et kort over slipstrømmen

programme.title: Andromeda: Illusionen om majestæt
programme.desc: Et forkert sving efter at have forladt en slipstream sender Andromeda ind i Prolon-systemet. De redder en flugtkapsel fra en sikker katastrofe, men stoltheden vil have den tilbage.

programme.title: Andromeda: Idolernes tusmørke
programme.desc: Besætningen søger efter en forsvundet koloni af nietzscheanere og opdager en anden besætning, der i hemmelighed har hjulpet dem

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission

programme.title: Jeff Ross: Roasts The Border

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mind and the Matter

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The Brennans’ legacy begins and ends in their enchanting Old Louisville home: nearly every member of the Brennan clan perished within its walls or had their funeral service held here.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Equipped with new insight into the Kentucky Anomaly and a bevy of compiled evidence of paranormal phenomena, the team returns to the Conrad-Caldwell Museum.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: My Wife As A Dog
programme.desc: A lonely fireman is obsessed with his dog, loving it more than his wife. He can fulfill his fondest wish when he finds a cursed dog leash that lets him slowly merge his wife and his dog into one being.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Eye Of Death
programme.desc: An antiques collector, Atticus Rook, makes a fortune selling as-new antiques from the Civil War era. It turns out that they are as-new by fuelling a cursed magic lantern with the blood of a victim

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Spirit Of Television
programme.desc: A psychic uses a cursed antique to trade her clients' lives for a temporary cure for her degenerative disease.

programme.title: Friday the 13th - The TV series
programme.desc: En spenningsserie som handler om det overnaturlige. I hver episode begir fire modige sjeler seg ut på et oppdrag i fare og redsel når de sporer opp og henter tilbake forbannede gjenstander. Mysteriet starter fra kl. 20 hver kveld.

programme.title: The Last Man on Earth
programme.desc: After watching the world around him become devastated by an apocalyptic plague which turns the living into a zombie-like creatures, Robert Morgan begins to lose hope until he encounters another survivor.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Architect Ray Reardon lives in a glittery dream world of upscale success. On the rebound from a recent divorce, Ray meets Lena Mathers and falls in love - but his dream turns to a nightmare as Lena leads him to the edge.

programme.title: Black Snake Moan
programme.desc: I denne kjærlighetshistorien søker Oscar-nominerte Samuel L. Jackson og Christina Ricci forløsning nede i sørstatene gjennom bluesens makt og transcendensen i et usannsynlig vennskap.

programme.title: Two Is Family
programme.desc: Samuel har et bekymringsløst liv på den franske rivieraen. Det er før Kristin, en tidligere flamme, kunngjør at han er far til en nyfødt, gir ham en babyjente og stikker!

programme.title: A Merry Holiday
programme.desc: Christy, en svært vellykket selger, stresser med å få en stor avtale. For å hjelpe henne må hun slå seg sammen med Jonathan som er opptatt med å lage en magisk jul for kjæresten sin. Konflikten er gitt, men noe annet begynner også å gry...

programme.title: American Siege
programme.desc: Den avdankede sheriffen i en liten by i Georgia, Ben Watts, blir presset til raskt å løse en gisselsituasjon – og innser snart at han er en brikke i et større spill blant byens skumle hemmeligheter.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: En kompromissløs mestertyv blir forrådt av medhjelperne og overlatt for å dø. Han utgir seg for å være en annen og samarbeider med en kvinne på innsiden for å sikre seg det seneste kuppet til gjengen.

programme.title: 97 Minutes
programme.desc: Et kapret fly vil styrte om bare 97 minutter når det går tom for drivstoff. NSA-direktøren vil at flyet skal skytes ned før den tid, og overlater skjebnen til de uskyldige passasjerene til en hemmelig Interpol-agent.

programme.title: Silver Saddle
programme.desc: En ung gutt som ser faren sin bli skutt ned, hevner seg ved å drepe leiemorderen. År senere har han vokst opp til å bli en suksessrik dusørjeger, fryktet av mange. Men en dag avsløres hemmeligheter fra fortiden hans…

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Wings of Desire aka Der Himmel über Berlin
programme.desc: En høyt lovprist og prisbelønnet film, som blant annet fikk prisen for beste regi i Cannes i 1987. Damiel er en ensom engel som streifer omkring i Berlins krigsmerkede gater og trøster dødelige i nød.

programme.title: Andromeda: Delenda Est
programme.desc: Gruppen som angrep Andromeda under den første undertegningen av Commonwealth-charteret, vender tilbake til mer kaos.

programme.title: Andromeda: The Dark Backward
programme.desc: Trance går gjennom noen forskjellige scenarier og prøver å finne en der mannskapet hennes ikke dør.

programme.title: Mutant X: No Exit
programme.desc: En mutant som har muligheten til å feste med hvilken som helst datamaskin med tankene sine, som er lammet etter et møte med teamet, tar over Sanctuarys datamaskiner.

programme.title: Mutant X: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet lærer om Lexas fremmede tvillingbror når han blir hovedmålet for en underjordisk operasjon som høster mutante organer.

programme.title: Mutant X: Possibilities
programme.desc: Brennan og Mutant X-teamet slår seg sammen med en tidsreisende mutant for å spre en bombe som truer ødeleggende konsekvenser.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Held For Ransom
programme.desc: Wealth has its rewards, but it also brings its dangers. Kidnapping is one of them. No ordeal is more horrifying for a family than to have a child taken.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Secret Santa

programme.title: RENO 911!: How We Do It in Reno

programme.title: RENO 911!: Fireworks

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Man in the Bottle
programme.desc: A luckless couple stumbles upon fortune when a genie materializes from a bottle in their antique shop. The genie grants them four wishes but warns them, prophetically, to be careful what you wish for.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Static

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: King Nine Will Not Return

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Shadow Play

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Nice Place to Visit

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Twenty-Two

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: Get Rich Or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: Etter en nesten-dødelig skytekamp husker Marcus reisen sin fra foreldreløs gategutt fra Bronx til å sitt preg på dopbransjen, til å slå seg sammen med en annen eks-fange (Terrence Howard) for å få en sjanse til å bli en vellykket rapper.

programme.title: The Adventures of Priscilla, Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: For three showgirls it was the dream of a lifetime, a four week cabaret engagement in Alice Springs. The problem is simply getting there intact, along with their bus Priscilla. It's not easy being a drag queen in the outback!

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: DISASTER MOVIE fortsetter den komiske nedturen til din yndlingsgruppe med latterlig attraktive 20-åringer. En skjebnesvanger natt prøver de å komme seg i trygghet mens enhver kjent naturkatastrofe, knuser byen og deres vei.

programme.title: Date Movie
programme.desc: Julia Jones jakter intenst på kjærligheten - alltid på feil sted- helt til hun slår kloa idrømmemannen. Men en slu eks, en fjertende katt og eksentriske svigers truer...

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En iskald leiemorder får sitt liv snudd på hodet når han blir forelsket i sitt mål, en sjarmerende svindler med uventede planer.

programme.title: Fortress
programme.desc: Den tidligere CIA-agenten Robert bor på et hemmelig feriested for tidligere spioner. Nå er hans sønn Paul havnet i trøbbel og trenger hans hjelp. Dessverre er ikke Pauls planer så hemmelige som livet til faren.

programme.title: The Ice Road
programme.desc: Etter at en fjerntliggende diamantgruve kollapser i Nord-Canada tar Mike oppdraget med å lede redningsoperasjonen, og må trosse de brutale naturkreftene i Canadas villmark.

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: En spirituell romantisk komedie, Ghost Town er historien om Bertram Pincus, en gretten tannlege på Manhattan som utvikler den uønskede evnen til å se døde folk.

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: Da Jack Deebs satt i fengsel skapte han Cool World, en tegneserie om hespetreet Holli Would. Men blod er tynnere enn blekk når Holli tar menneskelig form i Las Vegas.

programme.title: Mutant X: Conspiracy Theory
programme.desc: Mens Brennan og Shalimar etterforsker en mystisk flyulykke, tenker Lexa på fremtiden sin med Mutant X-teamet.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Devil Doll
programme.desc: En guide fører Sydney og Nigel til et uvanlig, underjordisk aztekisk gravkammer. I stedet for en kropp finner de en relikvie.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Incognito
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel henter en mytisk lansett, og støter på Nigels likhet like før hans død. Nigel får et kutt fra lansetten. Senere overtaler Cate Nigel til å etterligne mannen.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: All Choked Up
programme.desc: Carson Inez, en samler, bruker et gammelt halskjede for å få Sydney til å hjelpe henne med å oppdra Athena, som deretter vil hjelpe henne med å erobre verden.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Warlock of Nu Theta Phi
programme.desc: Når Sydneys student Megs romkamerat finner en hekses amulett, innlegger det Meg. Meg's kjærestes brorskap bror løper for å få amuletten. Hva gjør han?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Millionaire Murder
programme.desc: A businessman went to Florida to make one last deal before he retired-he never returned home to his millions. Authorities examined who was closest to him and who stood to gain from his disappearance. But this time conventional rules didn't apply.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Bounty Hunters / School Test / Going Down
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head become ace bounty hunters after a chance meeting with a reality TV. / With a big test looming, our favorite idiots receive an education in cheating. / Beavis and Butt-Head find themselves trapped in an elevator with a smokin hot chick

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Oil Change / Whiplash
programme.desc: After being instructed to change the oil in the fryer at Burger World, Beavis and Butt-head get the oil from a local gas station. / In an attempt to collect some big insurance money, Butt-head tries to give Beavis a whiplash injury while riding the school

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Candy Sale / To the Rescue
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head sell chocalate bars for their school. Well, the chocolate bars practically sell themselves. / Beavis and Butt-head witness a plane crash and appear in a cheesy reenactment on "Rescue 911."

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: A great day / Bride of Butt-Head / Special delivery
programme.desc: The school closes and makes the best day / Butt-Head phones in a mail-order bride / Burger World launches a home delivery service

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Stewart is Missing / Yard Sale
programme.desc: Mrs. Stevenson shows up at Butt-head's house, desperate to enlist their help in finding Stewart. / Tom Anderson get Beavis and Butt-head to watch his yard sale, and the boys manage to sell everything when they take the sale inside.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Tainted Meat / Bad Dog
programme.desc: Beavis and his bacteria ridden "thingy" contaminate the food at Burger World. / Beavis and Butt-head adopt a vicious dog at a shelter and it trains them.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Crisis line / Career day
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-Head set out to support callers on a crisis line / Later they go out on work experience as security guards

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: A Very Special Episode / Dumbasses Anonymous
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head come to the aid of a wounded baby bird...almost. / Beavis and Butt-head show up at an AA meeting hoping to score some booze.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Nektet service / Balleskvis
programme.desc: Beavis prøver yogabukser og får dem ikke av. / Guttene oppdager at de har rett til å nekte service til kunder på Burger World.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Execution Tickets
programme.desc: The deputies partake in a scavenger hunt to determine who gets to attend the execution of a convicted felon, and Williams gives a suspect a makeover.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clementine's Pregnant
programme.desc: A mandatory staff drug test reveals a surprise pregnancy, and Lt. Dangle has a brush with a celebrity.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Jones Gets Suspended
programme.desc: Jones enjoys some unexpected perks after being relegated to crossing guard duty, and Dangle's bike is stolen again.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Help From the FBI
programme.desc: While the FBI investigates a Reno homicide, members of the Sheriff's Department put their best feet forward.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel Suicide Watch
programme.desc: The Reno Sheriff's Department lavishes attention on Wiegel after her failed suicide attempt, and Williams and Garcia hook up.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clementine Gets Married
programme.desc: Clemmy's degenerate boyfriend Steed surprises everyone when he asks her to marry him.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Garcia's Anniversary
programme.desc: The guys hit a strip club to celebrate Garcia's 15-year anniversary on the force.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Burning Man Festival
programme.desc: When the Sheriff's Department receives $1200 to get people off the streets, Garcia helps a hooker, and Dangle heads to Burning Man.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Moving Day
programme.desc: Dangle needs help moving out of his house, and Junior teaches Reno's youth about prison life.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Sixteen-Millimeter Shrine
programme.desc: An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Trade-Ins
programme.desc: An elderly couple visit the New Life Corporation, hoping to transport their personalities into youthful artificial bodies.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Uncle Simon
programme.desc: Barbara accidentally causes her cruel Uncle Simon's death. His will stipulates that she must care for his latest invention - a robot. The robot begins to take on Uncle Simon's traits.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Four O'Clock
programme.desc: Oliver Crangle is a bitter, prejudiced man. Through unknown means, he intends to shrink every evil person in the world at four o'clock.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
programme.desc: Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Long Live Walter Jameson
programme.desc: Walter Jameson is an excellent history teacher who talks about the past as if he had lived it.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Still Valley
programme.desc: Confederacy scout Sgt. Joseph Paradine finds a town full of Union soldiers, and an old man who claims he used witchcraft to paralyze them.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Hunt
programme.desc: On a hunting trip, Hyder Simpson and his dog Rip dive into a lake after a raccoon. When he gets home he finds that no one can see or hear him.

programme.title: The Raven (1963)
programme.desc: The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: A mad scientist trying to cure polio must obtain human spinal fluid, and resorts to nefarious means by wearing an ape suit to procure victims for his experiment without being detected.

programme.title: What Maisie Knew
programme.desc: Julianne Moore, Alexander Skarsgård, Steve Coogan og Joanna Vanderham spiller hovedrollene i dette rørende dramaet om den uskyldig og sjarmerende seks år gamle Maisie som befinner seg midt i foreldrenes bitre foreldrerettkamp.

programme.title: Chloe & Theo
programme.desc: Chloe, en ung kvinne som bor på gatene i New York, møter den kloke inuitten Theo, som har blitt sendt til New York av sine "eldste" for å levere et budskap til verden.

programme.title: Youth in Revolt
programme.desc: Michael Cera (SUPERBAD) spiller Nick Twisp. En unik, men elskverdig tenåring med en smak for de sofistikerte tingene i livet. Han forelsker seg i den nydelige og intelligente Sheeni Saunders (Portia Doubleday) på campingferie med familien.

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: Den håpløst romantiske Wallace har droppet ut av medisinstudiet og har brent seg på kjærligheten. Når han møter Chantry, som dessverre er i et forpliktende forhold til kjæresten Ben, oppstår en umiddelbar gnist mellom dem.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Eks-agenten Bryan Mills er forsont med sin tidligere kone, men lykken blir kortvarig når hun brutalt myrdes og han blir beskyldt for udåden.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensjonerte CIA-agenten Robert legger ut på en dristig redningsaksjon av erkefiendens enke, Sasha. Men snart blir Robert konfrontert med et kjent ansikt han trodde han aldri ville se igjen...

programme.title: Mrs Henderson Presents
programme.desc: En eksentrisk enke åpner et teater med dristige revyforestillinger, som utfordrer moralen i et krigsherjet 1930-talls London.

programme.title: Blue Hawaii
programme.desc: Moren hans (Angela Lansbury) forventer at han skal stige på firmastigen. Men Elvis vil heller kle seg i Hawaii-skjorte enn dress, så han reiser for å jobbe som turistguide. Elvis er heldig: de første kundene hans er en bil full av søtinger.

programme.title: Andromeda: The Risk-All Point
programme.desc: Et kraftigere Andromeda-skip eksploderer på grunn av sannsynlig sabotasje, og tvinger Dylans mannskap til å redde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Den rette hesten
programme.desc: Beka setter både mannskapet og en hel planet i fare når en tidligere kjærlighet dukker opp.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hva skjer med en revidert utsatt?
programme.desc: Andromeda mottar et rop om hjelp fra pastor Bam.

programme.title: Andromeda: Spydspunktet
programme.desc: Etter at en Commonwealth-planet er angrepet av pyriske pyroformere, blir Dylan tvunget til å kjempe for å beskytte den nye planeten.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Under Fire
programme.desc: A series of armored car heists and bloody shoot-outs shocked law enforcement. The brutal violence of the crimes suggested a motive more complex than greed. When the robbers started targeting police, the FBI took charge.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: The Mystery of Morning Wood / U.S. History
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head try to stay awake all night, in an attempt to discover the secret behind morning wood. / For his oral report on an historical figure, Beavis recounts the valuable lessons he learned one night while eating at Burger World.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: En spirituell reise
programme.desc: Beavis ser ansiktet til Jesus i en nacho-chips. Det sender ham på en episk reise for å finne svar på det store spørsmålet - "Hvorfor får jeg aldri pult?"

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Nose Bleed / Vaya Con Cornholio
programme.desc: Butt-head tries some sadistic home remedies in an attempt to stop Beavis's nosebleed. / When Beavis turns into Cornholio in Burger World, Immigration Officials take him in as a possible illegal alien and try to make sense of his gibberish.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Give Blood / Beware of the Butt (aka Drive-In #1)
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head explore the career possibilities in selling blood. / While causing mischief at a drive-in movie theatre, Beavis & Butt-head experience a new phase of the moon.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Sick / For Better or Verse (aka Haiku)
programme.desc: Suffering from nasty colds, Beavis & Butt-head visit a doctor in hopes of glomming a prescription remedy. / Beavis & Butt-head's school assignment is to write a poem in the venerated Haiku format.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Figure Drawing / Date Bait
programme.desc: Beavis and Butt-head get to look at real nudes. / The return of Lolita and Tanqueray! Beavis and Butt-head go on their first date, well, almost.

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: To teite menn / Fredagsgalskap
programme.desc: Middelaldrende Beavis og Butt-Head oppfyller sin samfunnsplikt som jurymedlemmer./ Beavis og Butt-Head tror feilaktig at de har byttet kropp.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Car Wash / Kidnapped
programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head attempt to make some money washing cars. / Beavis & Butt-head decide that kidnapping Stewart would be a quick way to some cash.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Politically Correct / True Crime
programme.desc: To better understand their female classmates, Beavis & Butt-head must get in touch with their feelings. Huh huh, he said "touch." / Beavis & Butt-head unknowingly star in their favorite crime reenactment shows.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Terrorist Training Pt. 1
programme.desc: The Office of Homeland Security teaches the Reno Sheriff's Department terrorist attack protocol, and Clemmy's mom gets into trouble.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Terrorist Training Pt. 2
programme.desc: The Reno Sherriff's Department passes their Homeland Security exam with flying colors, and Clemmy and a drunk driver discover some new moves.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Halloween
programme.desc: On Halloween, the deputies prepare for a night of mayhem, and Wiegel sets a sting operation to catch mischievous teens.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Promotion
programme.desc: Dangle gets a new job in Carson City, but the deputies are too wrapped up in women's basketball to give him a proper send-off.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Wiegel's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: Wiegel's new boyfriend, Craig, bears an uncanny resemblance to the Truckee River Serial Killer.

programme.title: RENO 911!: British Law
programme.desc: Inspector Martin Smiley of the U.K. joins the Reno Sheriff's Department in an exchange program.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Wife Visits
programme.desc: Divorce looms over Dangle and his estranged wife, and the rest of the department struggles with a giant Ten Commandments monument.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Religion in Reno
programme.desc: The Reverend Gigg LeCarp, Reno's favorite televangelist, saves the deputies in their very own jail.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Fire Fighters Are Jerks
programme.desc: The accursed Fire Department schedules its Pancake Dinner at the same time as the Policeman's Ball.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Little People
programme.desc: An astronaut declares himself a god when his ship lands on a planet populated by people smaller than ants.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Last Night of a Jockey
programme.desc: A dejected jockey wants to be tall.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Dummy
programme.desc: A ventriloquist is convinced that his dummy, Willie, is alive and evil. He makes plans for a new act with a new dummy: plans that Willie doesn't support!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Four of Us are Dying
programme.desc: A man who can change his face to resemble others gets into hot water with gangsters.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Black Leather Jackets
programme.desc: Three tough-looking men on motorcycles disrupt a peaceful suburb when they move in. Yet the neighbors could never imagine just how dangerous these men really are.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Jungle
programme.desc: Alan Richards plans to build a dam in Africa on a tribe's ancestral land. The tribe's witch doctor puts a curse on him.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours
programme.desc: A woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist - and that her 'saleslady' is really a mannequin!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Lateness of the Hour
programme.desc: The daughter of an inventor objects to their 'perfect' home where they are waited on by mechanical servants.

programme.title: White Zombie
programme.desc: A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him. Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butikkmedarbeider oppdager en mystisk plante med en blodtørstig appetitt. Suksess følger, men prisen viser seg å være menneskeliv, og situasjonen eskalerer.

programme.title: Dark Star NO
programme.desc: Det er midten av 2000-tallet, og mennesket har utforsket hele solsystemet. Kolonister har forlatt jorden for å finne nye hjem i universet. Det væpnede romskipet "Dark Star" skal bane vei for alle de fredelige kolonistene.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: En inspirerende fortelling om basketballtrener Ken Carter, som fikk både ris og ros da han skapte overskrifter med å sette hele sitt ubeseirede lag på benken på grunn av dårlige akademiske prestasjoner.

programme.title: What's Eating Gilbert Grape
programme.desc: Gilbert føler seg innesperret, i en kjedelig amerikansk småby, med ansvar for sin autistiske lillebror og bevegelseshemmete mor. Men en dag kommer Becky til byen, og snart oppstår det et skjørt og spesielt vennskap dem imellom.

programme.title: Coneheads
programme.desc: Ett blikk, og du vet at de er fra et veldig rart sted. De er fra New Jersey, via "Frankrike", via Remulak langt ute på viddene. De er Coneheads.

programme.title: Chloe & Theo
programme.desc: Chloe, en ung kvinne som bor på gatene i New York, møter den kloke inuitten Theo, som har blitt sendt til New York av sine "eldste" for å levere et budskap til verden.

programme.title: Jackass Number Two
programme.desc: Forbered deg på ukontrollerbare latterkramper og kvalmebølger når gutta kaster sine forslåtte kropper inn i en rekke absurde situasjoner.Jackass Number Two det er en komedie du vil se igjen og igjen.

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Etter en romantisk kveld i deres avsidesliggende hus, våkner Emma opp lenket til sin døde ektemann. Hun er fanget og isolert og må kjempe mot leiemordere for å unnslippe ektemannens avsindige plan.

programme.title: Official Secrets
programme.desc: Den sanne historien om en britisk varsler som lekket informasjon til media om en ulovlig NSA-operasjon, hvis formål var å presse FNs sikkerhetsråd til å godkjenne invasjonen av Irak i 2003.

programme.title: Wagons East
programme.desc: De var ute etter gull, men nå tar de til takke med innlagt vann. John Candy og Richard Lewis spiller i dette hysterisk ukonvensjonelle blikket på den legendariske ville vesten.

programme.title: Easy Come, Easy Go (1967)
programme.desc: On his last day in the Navy, frogman Elvis discovers a sunken treasure ship. On his first day as a civilian, Elvis starts his new job—self-employed treasure hunter!

programme.title: Mutant X: Art of Attraction
programme.desc: Mens Mutant X-teamet kjemper for å hente en formel gjemt i en samling kunstverk, får Shalimar viktig informasjon fra en mystisk kilde.

programme.title: Mutant X: A Normal Life
programme.desc: Mutant X sporer opp en useriøs forsker mens Shalimar bryter seg bort fra teamet for å hjelpe Adam med å redde forskeren - og avdekke den virkelige dårlige fyren.

programme.title: Mutant X: Divided Loyalties
programme.desc: Brennan blir tvunget til å gå tilbake til sin kriminelle fortid når Mutant X oppdager at hans gamle partner er involvert i å stjele hemmeligheter fra Dominion.

programme.title: Mutant X: Age of Innocence
programme.desc: Mutant X avdekker et gammelt militært eksperiment som involverer et aldersreverseringsserum og er overrasket over å oppdage at bestefaren til Jesse er en av testpersonene.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: Mens Sydney holder foredrag om indianerne som møtte en mystisk katastrofe 600 år tidligere, gir en innfødt henne en relikvie fra den tiden. Hva er hemmeligheten?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Global Pursuit
programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Trail
programme.desc: The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Where is Everybody?

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Trouble with Templeton

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Silence

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Lateness of the Hour

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Static
programme.desc: An old radio is taking bitter bachelor Ed Lindsay back to a happier time before what he considers worthless tripe on television when he starts picking up radio programs from the 1930's and 1940's.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Number Twelve Looks Just Like You

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: The Ghoul
programme.desc: A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead. The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

programme.title: 10 Items or Less
programme.desc: Oscar®-vinnaren Morgan Freeman spelar här en filmstjärna som ger sig ut på rollförberedande research i ett snabbköp i Los Angeles. Han möter en snabbtalande kassörska och de ger sig av på en gemensam resa för att visa varandra sina respektive världar.

programme.title: Familjen Bélier
programme.desc: I familjen Bélier är alla döva förutom 16-åriga Paula, som tar hand om alla utom sig själv. Hon fungerar som sina föräldrars språkrör i deras vardagsliv och är oumbärlig för alla i familjen. Vad hennes föräldrar inte vet är att deras dotter har…

programme.title: Now Add Honey
programme.desc: Carolines liv är i fullständigt fritt fall. Hennes döttrar driver henne till vansinne och hennes otacksamma chef håller på köra slut på henne samtidigt som hennes man lämnar henne.

programme.title: I Feel Pretty
programme.desc: Amy Schumer spelar rollen som Renee, en ung kvinna som varje dag febrilt försöker övervinna sin osäkerhet och sin känsla av otillräcklighet.

programme.title: Taken 3
programme.desc: Liam Neeson är tillbaka som Bryan Mills. Men denna gång är det han själv som hamnar i knipa då han blir jagad för ett mord han inte begått.

programme.title: TAKEN
programme.desc: Bryan, en före detta CIA-agent har svårt att släppa sin gamla yrkesroll och ser faror överallt. När hans dotter, Kim, åker till Paris, besannas hans värsta mardröm, hon kidnappas.

programme.title: The Little Shop Of Horrors
programme.desc: En butiksanställd upptäcker en mystisk växt med en blodtörstig aptit. Framgång följer, men priset visar sig vara människoliv, och situationen eskalerar.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Westernstjärnan Bud Spencer spelar en godhjärtad men järnnävad bananodlare som bor i en liten djungelby. Ett stort bananföretag vill exploatera byn, och när Joe sätter sig på tvären bestämmer sig företagsledaren – en gangster – att sätta dit honom.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper 2.0

programme.title: Andromeda: Tvångsperspektiv

programme.title: Mutant X: Det nya århundradets brott

programme.title: RENO 911!: British Law
programme.desc: Inspector Martin Smiley of the U.K. joins the Reno Sheriff's Department in an exchange program.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Dangle's Wife Visits
programme.desc: Divorce looms over Dangle and his estranged wife, and the rest of the department struggles with a giant Ten Commandments monument.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Religion in Reno
programme.desc: The Reverend Gigg LeCarp, Reno's favorite televangelist, saves the deputies in their very own jail.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Fire Fighters Are Jerks
programme.desc: The accursed Fire Department schedules its Pancake Dinner at the same time as the Policeman's Ball.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Not Without My Mustache
programme.desc: As the deputies struggle to save their moustaches from a county-ordered shave, Jones worries about a psychic's prediction.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Security for Kenny Rogers
programme.desc: Deputy Garcia lives his lifelong dream: leading security for a Kenny Rogers book signing.

programme.title: RENO 911!: More FBI Help
programme.desc: When the lieutenant governor's brother goes missing, the FBI swings in to help the deputies.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Raineesha X
programme.desc: Williams discovers the Nation of Islam and changes her ways, while Clemmy and Dangle throw down at a fraternity costume contest.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Clementine and Garcia are Dating
programme.desc: After getting it on with nearly every other man in Reno, Johnson finally hooks up with Garcia, and Dangle breaks out his chimney sweep costume.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Undercover Drug Bust
programme.desc: Jones and Garcia enjoy their undercover stakeout a little too much, and Dangle and Clemmy start the department's first rock band.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Changing of the Guard
programme.desc: An elderly private school teacher wonders if his life has meant anything as he contemplates suicide on Christmas Eve and is reminded by former students that he has, indeed, had an impact on their lives.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Probe 7, Over and Out
programme.desc: The lone survivors of two annihilated worlds are stranded on a distant planet.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Encounter
programme.desc: A World War II veteran and a Japanese-American gardener battle each other over a war that ended more than 20 years ago.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Odyssey of Flight 33
programme.desc: Passing through the sound barrier a commercial airliner inadvertently travels back in time.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Self-Improvement of Salvadore Ross
programme.desc: A man finds that he can trade anything he has, including youth and personality, with anybody else.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The After Hours
programme.desc: A woman discovers that the floor of a department store, on which she bought a gold thimble, doesn't exist - and that her 'saleslady' is really a mannequin!

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Dingle, the Strong
programme.desc: A timid vacuum-cleaner salesman is given the strength of 300 men by some experimenting aliens.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Kick the Can
programme.desc: The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."

programme.title: Troll
programme.desc: When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

programme.title: Night Tide
programme.desc: Johnny, a sailor on leave from the Navy, sees Mora at a nightclub and is infatuated with her. As she warms up to him, he begins to suspect she is not human and soon discovers her secret.

programme.title: Z for Zachariah
programme.desc: En ung kvinna verkar vara den enda överlevaren efter ett kärnvapenkrig, och hon lever på egen hand, helt utan någon omkring sig. Men en dag får hon syn på den största överraskningen i sitt liv: en annan människa.

programme.title: Like Crazy
programme.desc: En brittisk collegestudent faller för en amerikansk student. De måste sedan skiljas åt när USA förbjuder henne att vara i landet efter att visumet har passerat.

programme.title: Mousehunt
programme.desc: Bröderna Lars och Ernie Smuntz har haft en rad motgångar och tror inte särskilt mycket på den gamla herrgården de ärver – tills de upptäcker att den förfallna fastigheten i själva verket är värd miljoner.

programme.title: Chloe & Theo
programme.desc: Chloe, en ung kvinna som lever på gatan i New York, möter den vise inuiten Theo, som har skickats till New York av sina ”äldste” för att överlämna ett budskap till världen.

programme.title: The Big White
programme.desc: För att lindra sina ekonomiska problem söker en anställd på en resebyrå efter ett fruset lik, som råkar vara eftertraktat av två mördare.

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Efter en romantisk kväll i deras hus nere vid sjön vaknar Emma fängslad vid sin döde man. Avskuren från allt mitt i vintern måste hon värja sig mot lejda mördare för att kunna undfly sin mans sjuka plan.

programme.title: The Kelly Gang
programme.desc: Den sanna historien om den sista australiska banditen Ned Kelly, hans gäng och deras flykt från rättvisan.

programme.title: Ruskiga Rekryter - In war with the army
programme.desc: Alvin (Jerry Lewis) och Vic (Dean Martin) är kompisar som söker värvning i armén, främst därför att Vic har problem med sin flickvän och söker sig via det militära till en tjänstgöring i Europa.

programme.title: Supersnutarna
programme.desc: Matt och Wilbur är två hårdslående bråkmakare, men med hjärtat på rätta stället. Efter ett misslyckat rånförsök i Miami hamnar de av misstag på stadens polisskola.

programme.title: Legend of the Demon Cat
programme.desc: Filmen kommer från den BAFTA-prisbelönte regissören Chen Kaige och utspelar sig under Tangdynastin. En demonkatt dyker plötsligt upp och stör friden i staden Chang'an och orsakar en rad märkliga händelser.

programme.title: Mutant X: En vitare nyans av blek
programme.desc: En ny mutant med förmågan att vara osynlig arbetar mot både Eckhart och Adam, trots att hon var involverad med Adam i det förflutna.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dubbel syn
programme.desc: En gammal vän till Brennan lockar honom och Emma i en fälla. Emma slutar med att splittras upp i två separata enheter, en god och en ond.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Nio liv
programme.desc: Alla som stjäl en staty som föreställer den egyptiska kattgudinnan Mafdet dödas. Nu har statyn försvunnit och Sidney och Nigel har fått i uppdrag att hämta den.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Affaire de Coeur
programme.desc: Sydney och Nigel åker till Skottland för att hitta den andra ringen i Calums och Elenas par av Twining Rings.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Återuppsättningen
programme.desc: Kuba, Afrika 100 e.Kr: Wootes dyrkare förbannar hans idol för att skydda den. 2000: Ross Crawford kommer till Sydney eftersom han tog idolen och förbannelsen har påskyndat hans åldrande.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.desc: Bud's new driver's license portends bumper cars on the roadway. When bud t-bones a Mercedes, Al sees an opportunity to clean up in court. At least he has hope. Losing his lawsuit hurt but what he goes through to payoff the settlement is truly painful.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Unnatural
programme.desc: Al is cut from the neighborhood softball team just before the big game. When his all-star replacement is knocked out in the last inning, however, his team and family have to come crawling back.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: The Dance Show
programme.desc: Peggy goes out dancing with Marcy, and becomes taken with a handsome man-about-town named Andy. At home, however, Al gets confronted by Andy's wife, Pete.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Kelly Bounces Back
programme.desc: Now an aspiring model, Kelly invents a maneuver called "The Bundy Bounce" for her first audition as spokesperson for the new Allente car.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Married…with Aliens
programme.desc: After Al returns home from work with a bump on the head, he sees (or thinks he sees) six little green aliens coming down to Earth and stealing his smelly socks to use as fuel for their spaceships.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Wabbit Season
programme.desc: Al decides to grow a vegetable garden, but soon faces off against an all-out war with a rabbit who steals his carrots and other vegetables.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: Do Ya Think I'm Sexy
programme.desc: When Al moves a sofa off a neighbor's lawn without a shirt on, he unexpectedly gains a reputation as a "stud" among the neighborhood women.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: One Down, Two to Go
programme.desc: Tired of Al escorting her dates out through the doorway, "grown-up" Kelly gets her own apartment.

programme.title: Våra värsta år: And Baby Makes Money
programme.desc: After Al's bachelor uncle dies, he leaves $500,000 to the first of his relatives to produce a newborn baby named after him. Al overcomes his usual aversion to sex with Peg.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Bus trip / Green thumbs
programme.desc: The class goes on a roadtrip / Beavis and Butt dabble into counterfeit money using a photocopier

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Politically Correct / True Crime
programme.desc: To better understand their female classmates, Beavis & Butt-head must get in touch with their feelings. Huh huh, he said "touch." / Beavis & Butt-head unknowingly star in their favorite crime reenactment shows.

programme.title: Beavis and Butt-Head: Follow me / Nothing happening / Take a lap
programme.desc: Beavis starts mimicing Butt-Head / A quiet day in Highland, Texas / Our duo enrolls in a fitness class

programme.title: Mike Judge's Beavis & Butt-Head: Den nya fienden / Dubbelgångaren
programme.desc: Tvättbjörnar stjäl Beavis och Butt-Heads nachos,och pojkarna slår tillbaka./ Beavis misstar en främling för Butthead, och blir sen inte av med honom.

programme.title: RENO 911!: President Bush in Reno

programme.title: RENO 911!: Accidental Marriage

programme.title: RENO 911!: Milkshake Man's Death
